sermon.title: The Race — August 18, 2024
sermon.speaker: Unidentified speaker (not clearly Pastor Kincer), likely Michael Silla
sermon.summary: Saved by grace, we still run a race. Jesus calls us out of dead, stony hearts like Lazarus, and we stay on track by turning from evil. The goal is to overcome the thief, his lies and our flesh. Like Olympians, train the spirit, lay aside every weight, and keep improving even in small steps.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. faqs.question: Can you win in the kingdom?
faqs.answer: Yes; you can win a gold medal in the kingdom.

faqs.question: Can you be strong outside but dead inside?
faqs.answer: Yes; the fastest runner or a millionaire can have a dead spirit.

faqs.question: What if Jesus speaks?
faqs.answer: You better get out of the way, because it’s about to happen.

faqs.question: What substances?
faqs.answer: Fentanyl, drugs, alcohol: if it’s ruling your life, turn from it.

faqs.question: Is brushing your teeth a work?
faqs.answer: Yes; coming to church is too.

faqs.question: Are ladies excluded?
faqs.answer: No; all of us are kings and priests.

faqs.question: What is happening to identity?
faqs.answer: Today we throw God’s identities out.

faqs.question: Do we like junk food?
faqs.answer: Yes, but decide what goes into your spiritual man.

faqs.question: Why sing I Pledge Allegiance?
faqs.answer: There are a lot of flags and many want our allegiance; give it to Christ.
